summary: Checks the pinned demo storyline for the Opportunity Map against the live saved signals, and can record or fake the recorded Ask AI answer.
purpose: Keeps the LNG demo honest: every pinned signal, source, and cited answer must still exist and still match the filter.
why: The header says the pins live in the client bundle because the demo serves them without any server call, so this script is the only check.
how: It loads the storyline JSON, reads the saved signals the same way the server does, and applies the client filter. With no flag it checks each pin and exits 1 on failure. With --capture it runs a real search and saves the answer. With --placeholder it saves a keyword-based answer marked as placeholder.
inputs: The storyline JSON in the capital-projects demo folder, the database rows for opportunity signals, and command-line flags.
outputs: Console messages and an exit code. The two flags rewrite the storyline JSON file.
risks: The --capture and --placeholder flags overwrite the recorded answer in the storyline file. The placeholder answer is not a real model answer.
debug: Run with no flags and read the failure list. If a pinned signal is missing, check whether its source was removed or its industry changed.
